evidence: For the gas-phase deposition of CuInS thin films the metal precursors CuCl (Aldrich 98% ) and InCl3 (Aldrich 99% ) are used, along with H2S (purity 4.82 Hoekloos) as the sulfur precursor. Between two pulses of different reactants, the reaction chamber is purged with argon. The metal precursors are evaporated from quartz boats inside the oven and the vapors are carried to the reactor by an argon flow.
